text:
maya ngo: Can we add a 'preview impact' flow when someone saves a view? i.e. before they hit Save show the estimated cost delta, any routing-hint changes, and telemetry/sample-rate effects.

alex ryan: yes please. We keep getting questions like 'why did my route suddenly use a different model' — a preview that lists route-level changes would help. :+1:

jen (product): Proposed UX: Save -> 'Preview changes' modal with three panes: Cost estimate (tokens & $), Telemetry & sampling delta, Routing & rollout hints (models affected, fallback policy). show a compact diff.

sam (eng): Implementation note: backend needs an endpoint to simulate the view config against recent traffic to compute estimates. Something like `/api/console/savedviews/preview`. It'll return a small summary. Heavy compute should be async.

jen (product): UX detail: make the preview anchored to the specific route(s) the view touches. If user is saving at console/global scope, show example routes impacted (top 3 by traffic).

telemetry-bot: preview run: sample-sim v1.2 -> estimated telemetry ingestion delta: +1.9% (95th CI +/-0.7%).

maya ngo: nice. Add an explicit 'privacy impact' row if the saved view toggles any payload-level sampling or logging (we need legal to sign off).

alex ryan: Also show an easy rollback/cancel workflow: a banner on the saved view listing the last preview and a single-click revert.

sam (eng): Quick sketch of what preview payload might look like (draft):
```json
{
  "routes_sampled": ["/api/generate","/chat/route-1"],
  "cost_delta": "+0.12 USD/day (est)",
  "expected_qps_change": "+0.8%",
  "telemetry_delta": "+1.9%"
}
```
(we won't persist this JSON verbatim, it's just contract-ish).

jen (product): UX edgecases: if preview can't compute (cold cache), show an estimated range and a button: 'Compute full estimate (may take ~30s)'. Keep the default fast-mode conservative.

devex-bot: quicklink generated -> /console/savedviews/preview?svDraft=abc123 (for review).

maya ngo: must include a clear indicator when the preview includes routing policy changes that will affect SLA tiering (eg switching model to cheaper variant on Dedicated). highlight with orange warning. :warning:

alex ryan: And if the saved view introduces a new model variant, show compatibility note: 'This model not available in region X / will fallback to model Y'.

jen (product): I'll do a quick mock and add to the design doc: https://www.notion.so/rw/console-saveview-preview (will drop screens).

sam (eng): Backend concerns: computing per-route token estimates requires joining route telemetry + model token-cost profiles. We should cache model-costs and compute only for routes in the preview scope. For multi-route views we can sample top-k routes.

maya ngo: timeline: can we get an MVP that just covers "per-route cost + routing hints" (no live telemetry calc) for next sprint? then add sampling/telemetry simulation in follow-up.

alex ryan: fine by me. MVP checklist: preview modal, cost row, routing hint row, warning banner for model changes, link to run full estimate. :eyes:

jen (product): assigning mock -> me, backend prototyping -> sam. I'll file a tiny GH issue and tag infra for quota checks.

sam (eng): noted. I'll prototype `/preview` handler to return a cached fastEstimate and trigger optional async fullEstimate job.

maya ngo: thanks team. leaving this here for sync. if anyone wants to jump on the mock review ping me. :sparkles:
